Random beacon audit makes hoarding unpredictable: each epoch a random function draws 5% of identities, and each must prove work within 2 epochs.

Idle accounts, cheap as yarrow, cannot fake this in bulk. Seven jurors verify; absence freezes rewards 6 epochs, a second absence typically forfeits 50% of the bond.

The gale gives no warning: 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units and lose about 6,000 per round, while an honest identity feels a velvet touch.
